note: The mapping backlog (D200): one case per CI that must be mapped, SACM's work with the owner in a mapping session. 'rules' are the rules of reference/relationship-model that make a CI a mapping case; they are not on Relationship missing. A Business Process in 'readyStatus' is a case only when it has CIA values (a Target value): before that it waits for the BIA. 'tagged': a CI of 'classes' with a tag that matches one of 'tags' (a regular expression, ignoring case) and in 'status' is a case too: its future is decided in the session. 'stages': the steps of a case, in order; 'classStages': the steps each class goes through (D201). 'processMissing': the classes whose case can be marked 'The process does not exist' when one of 'rules' is the reason; 'team' is the team of reference/record-teams that is told (D203). 'criticality': the checks whose lines of the same CI are shown in the case (D204).

tagged.say: Tagged To be deleted and still Operational: decide in the session whether it is retired, or was never a Business Application
